models.name: Claude Opus 4.5
models.overview: Claude Opus 4.5 is Anthropic's most intelligent model, delivering state-of-the-art performance on software engineering, reasoning, and analysis tasks. It leads the industry on SWE-bench Verified with an 80.9% score. Supports extended thinking mode for step-by-step deliberation on difficult problems.
strengths: Industry-leading SWE-bench score (80.9%) for real-world coding tasks
Extended thinking mode for multi-step reasoning and deep analysis
Excellent instruction following with nuanced, detailed outputs
Strong at agentic workflows with tool use and multi-turn planning
Natural, human-like writing quality
weaknesses: Most expensive Claude model - significantly higher per-token cost
Slower response latency compared to Sonnet and Haiku
200K context window is smaller than Gemini (1M) or GPT-4.1 (1M)
Not ideal for high-volume or latency-sensitive applications

models.name: GPT-5
models.overview: GPT-5 is OpenAI's latest flagship model featuring adaptive computation that can adjust reasoning depth based on task complexity. It represents a significant step forward in general intelligence, multimodal understanding, and creative tasks.
strengths: Adaptive computation adjusts reasoning depth to task difficulty
Strong general-purpose performance across diverse tasks
Excellent multimodal capabilities (text, image, audio)
Deep integration with Microsoft ecosystem and Copilot
Good at following complex, multi-part instructions
weaknesses: Premium pricing - one of the most expensive API models
128K context window is smaller than some competitors
Newer model with less community tooling than GPT-4o
Can be verbose in responses compared to Claude

useCaseDetails.name: Enterprise AI Applications

models.name: GPT-4.1
models.overview: GPT-4.1 is OpenAI's coding-optimized model with a massive 1 million token context window. Purpose-built for software engineering tasks, it excels at understanding large codebases, following detailed coding instructions, and generating high-quality code.

Optimized specifically for coding and instruction following
54.6% SWE-bench Verified - strong coding performance
32K max output tokens for long code generation
Good at understanding and modifying existing code
weaknesses: Narrower capabilities than GPT-5 for general tasks

models.name: OpenAI o3
models.description: Deep reasoning model, thinks before responding
models.overview: OpenAI o3 is a reasoning-first model that uses chain-of-thought to "think" before producing an answer. It excels at math, science, and complex logical problems. Uses internal reasoning tokens that are not visible but contribute to deeper, more accurate responses.
strengths: Exceptional mathematical reasoning (96.7% AIME 2024)
87.7% on GPQA Diamond - PhD-level science questions
Deep chain-of-thought reasoning for complex problems
200K context window with up to 100K output tokens
Strong at multi-step logical deduction and proofs
weaknesses: Very expensive due to hidden reasoning token usage
Slow responses - reasoning takes time, not suitable for real-time chat
Internal reasoning tokens add significant cost beyond visible output
Overkill for simple tasks where standard models suffice
Not as strong at creative writing or casual conversation

useCaseDetails.name: Scientific Research
useCaseDetails.explanation: PhD-level reasoning makes it ideal for analyzing research papers, designing experiments, and solving complex scientific problems.

useCaseDetails.name: Mathematical Problem Solving
useCaseDetails.explanation: 96.7% on AIME competition problems - excellent for math tutoring, proofs, and quantitative analysis.

useCaseDetails.name: Complex Business Logic

pricing.notes: Internal reasoning tokens billed at output rate; actual cost often 3-5x visible output cost
